releases.headline: From construction to observation.
releases.abstract: AURORA marks the point where RHEN stops being primarily a system under construction and becomes a system expected to produce controlled, reconstructable live evidence. The live executor remains deterministic while evidence, reporting, research, and pre-open observation are separated into bounded layers.
releases.thesis: AURORA's first responsibility is to prove that RHEN can operate safely, leave a complete evidence trail, and distinguish operational defects from strategy outcomes.

capabilities.label: EXECUTION
capabilities.title: Guarded deterministic live trading
capabilities.body: RHEN owns production decisions, risk gates, sizing, reconciliation, order submission, and position management. Research has no production execution authority.

capabilities.label: EVIDENCE
capabilities.title: Canonical decision and outcome telemetry
capabilities.body: Runs, cycles, candidates, rejection reasons, order intents, fills, exits, incidents, provenance, forward outcomes, and MFE/MAE can be preserved for reconstruction.

capabilities.label: REPORTING
capabilities.title: Daily and weekly operating research
capabilities.body: Post-close and weekly reports expose candidate funnels, consistency warnings, evidence gaps, outcome summaries, and durable research questions.

capabilities.label: RESEARCH
capabilities.title: Research Agent proposal and freeze foundation
capabilities.body: Deterministic proposal checks, availability-only feasibility, methodology freeze, exact authorization, and protected-stage workflow controls exist without an active LLM runtime.

capabilities.label: PRE-OPEN
capabilities.title: Shadow market-state observation
capabilities.body: Pre-Open State v1 records context before the U.S. session and realized outcomes later. It is shadow-only and has no live-order authority.

capabilities.label: SAFETY
capabilities.title: Research cannot silently become production
capabilities.body: Development, validation, and holdout openings require exact durable authorization. A semantic recommendation alone cannot change experiment workflow state.

architecture.title: Broker + market data
architecture.body: Account, order, position, clock, and configured market-data state.

architecture.title: Live executor
architecture.body: Exclusive production execution, risk, sizing, reconciliation, and position authority.

architecture.title: Canonical evidence
architecture.body: Durable telemetry that can reconstruct why an opportunity was accepted, rejected, or exited.

architecture.title: Reporting
architecture.body: Daily and weekly synthesis of operating state, evidence quality, and research questions.

architecture.title: Research Agent foundation
architecture.body: Bounded experiment design and authorization infrastructure, still dormant as a runtime agent.

architecture.title: Pre-Open State v1
architecture.body: Independent shadow collection of pre-open context and later outcomes.

verification.label: STRATEGY
verification.body: Active live strategy identity at release freeze.

verification.label: INCIDENTS
verification.body: No unresolved operational incidents at the Sunday release freeze.

verification.label: STAGE TWO
verification.body: Focused Research Agent tests and full implementation-baseline suite reported passing.

limitations.title: Small clean live sample
limitations.body: The current architecture has not yet accumulated a long cross-session evidence history. One session cannot establish profitability or robustness.

limitations.title: IEX feed constraints
limitations.body: The configured basic equity feed is not consolidated SIP coverage. Research preserves feed identity instead of silently substituting another source.

limitations.title: Research Agent runtime not active
limitations.body: No LLM provider, research-agent Railway service, scheduler, or autonomous protected-stage opening exists in AURORA.

limitations.title: No promoted Pre-Open predictive model
limitations.body: The pre-open layer collects evidence only. No released predictive model influences live execution.
